thread.listingTitle: Shower inside the room at Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast

messages.text: Hey lovely! I’m Stu, I’m a 25 year old woman. I’m currently looking for accomodation to move into by Monday the 30th. I was wondering if you’d be open to have if a chat to see if I would be a good fit to your house and if I can then inspect the house. I’m interested in the room with the ensuite. Please let me know! Thank you :)

Hi! We're doing inspections next Thursday at 1pm.
Would you like to come?
📍 4/44 Watson Esplanade, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217
Mathis will be there to assist you.
Message when you arrive: +61 411 590 261
Hey Jess, I would like to attend the inspection. Thank you 😄
